Main-reader mathematical check (statement151.033.last_paragraph.extension_from_exact_sequence): assuming the displayed usual based homotopy sequence is exact and its fibre connected, pi_1(total) maps onto pi_1(base), with kernel the image, hence a quotient, of pi_1(fibre). This verifies the stated group-extension consequence conditionally. It does not prove that the proposed geometric/to-pos construction has such a fibration, nor the asserted local non-disconnection equivalence; no source reading changes. The actual proof event is recorded in CHECK_EVENTS.tsv.

check_events.who: GPT-6 Astra Pro; effort not exposed; SP93_C13_151 /root
check_events.outcome: Conditional on the displayed sequence being exact in the usual based homotopy-sequence sense and on the fibre being connected: the map from the base fundamental group to pi_0 of the fibre has a singleton target, so exactness makes pi_1(total) -> pi_1(base) surjective. Exactness at pi_1(total) identifies its kernel with the image of pi_1(fibre), which is a quotient of pi_1(fibre) by the kernel of the preceding group homomorphism. Hence 1 -> image(pi_1(fibre)) -> pi_1(total) -> pi_1(base) -> 1 is a group extension, as the final paragraph states. This checks only that algebraic consequence. It does not prove the proposed homotopy fibration, the asserted local non-disconnection equivalence, or a topos/profinite version of the displayed sequence. No manuscript sign, capitalization or index is changed by the check.
